project_info.theme: Short-expiry clearance basket with hero price
project_info.color_palette: Near Black, Deep Olive Gold, Bright Yellow, White, Warm Gold

main_subject.detail: A dark premium clearance poster with {{SALE_HEADLINE}} at the top, a glossy gold {{PRICE_VALUE}} centered above a large yellow shopping basket filled with REF_CLEARANCE_PRODUCTS and visible {{EXPIRY_LABEL}} tags.
main_subject.style: Dramatic ecommerce clearance visual, 3D gold price, realistic snack packshots, hard retail contrast

composition_elements.type: Price hero / basket / product packshots / tags
composition_elements.text: Use {{SALE_HEADLINE}}, {{PRICE_PREFIX}}, {{PRICE_VALUE}}, {{EXPIRY_LABEL}}, and {{FOOTER_CTA}}. Do not hide expiry information.
items: Top: Large yellow {{SALE_HEADLINE}} on deep olive-black panels.
Lower Center: Yellow REF_BASKET_PROP with REF_CLEARANCE_PRODUCTS in a dense but readable arrangement.
Basket tags: Multiple visible {{EXPIRY_LABEL}} tags on eligible products.
Bottom: White rounded CTA badge with {{FOOTER_CTA}}.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy gold 3D price, hard product highlights, gold confetti, black vignetting

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup clearance poster. Preserve the black/olive premium background, large yellow {{SALE_HEADLINE}}, {{PRICE_PREFIX}} plus a glossy 3D gold {{PRICE_VALUE}}, a central yellow REF_BASKET_PROP filled with REF_CLEARANCE_PRODUCTS, clearly visible {{EXPIRY_LABEL}} tags, and a white rounded footer with {{FOOTER_CTA}}. Keep expiry disclosure prominent and product packs true to reference.
prompt.negative_prompt: missing expiry disclosure, ambiguous date, hidden product labels, distorted snack packaging, incorrect currency, unapproved discount, low contrast, watermark, cropped basket

assets.name: Clearance basket price composition
assets.usage: Preserve headline, 3D price, basket center, tags, and footer CTA.

assets.name: Eligible clearance SKU packshots
assets.source: Attach approved packshots with verified expiry status
assets.usage: Fill basket while retaining readable individual labels.

assets.name: Yellow shopping basket
assets.source: Use original basket crop or recreate neutral yellow basket
assets.usage: Keep basket as the central product container.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach REF_LAYOUT and verified eligible REF_CLEARANCE_PRODUCTS. Add final expiry/date/currency text in post-production and obtain human review before publishing.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Replace only with verified current SGD price.
Use approved disclosure wording; never remove expiry qualifier.
